method: Read-only local inputs; no source manifest rebinding, rebuild, or installation.

Current top-level and recursively nested JAR assets/data; KubeJS same-path overrides. Deterministic filename order is not runtime collision evidence. Selected external resource packs are not treated as upstream.
Historical global language inventory omitted some nested/developer/project-generated keys. Newly observed keys are review candidates, not proven version additions or missing translations.
Markdown text hashes normalize CRLF/CR to LF; Patchouli uses raw UTF-8 hashes, matching historical extraction.

Global language inventory is historical 1.4.0 scope; maintained-language comparisons use current batch snapshots and accepted CFPA decisions. Complete current language snapshots are saved for future audits.

old: The &dPurifier&r allows you to remove &5Enchantments&r and &cCurses&r from items using blood.
